meta.name: Open Movie Collection
meta.description: Blender's open movies, one per episode: the films that started open animation.

videos.title: Elephants Dream
videos.overview: Two men explore a strange, endless machine, and disagree about what it is. The first open movie.

videos.title: Big Buck Bunny
videos.overview: A giant, gentle rabbit takes revenge on three bullying rodents in a comedy from the Blender Institute.

videos.title: Sintel
videos.overview: A lonely young woman searches the world for the baby dragon she raised and lost.

videos.title: Tears of Steel
videos.overview: In a future Amsterdam, a group of scientists tries to save the world from robots by restaging a breakup that went wrong.

videos.title: Cosmos Laundromat
videos.overview: On a desolate island, a suicidal sheep meets a mysterious salesman who offers him the gift of a lifetime.
